title: CS787 Project: Modeling Tabular Data using CTGAN
summary: A class project (CS787) whose stated purpose is modeling tabular data with CTGAN, and it vendors the DataCebo ctgan package (including its TVAE synthesizer and rdt-based data transformer) directly into the repository. SDV's ctgan library is copied in-tree as the project's core generative model.
evidence: ctgan/__init__.py: '__author__ = "DataCebo, Inc."' with CTGAN/TVAE imported; ctgan/data_transformer.py imports rdt.transformers
needs: No README or notebook evidence shows the vendored ctgan package actually being invoked (fit/sample) outside its own module code; usage beyond vendoring is unverified.
